EP48:E3 2400-7500 CATHERINE [Vindictive, Cold]: "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."

EP48:E5 7800-12300 ACTION: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
EP48:E6 8000-12300 CATHERINE [Scheming]: "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."

EP48:E8 12600-14900 CATHERINE [Intense, Measured]: "Ten days for the council to sit."
EP48:E9 15000-18500 ACTION: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
EP48:E10 15100-17200 CATHERINE [Calculating]: "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."
EP48:E11 17400-19700 CATHERINE [Dark, Threatening]: "Ten days for a decree to be undone."

EP48:E13 20100-23700 CATHERINE [Menacing, Resolute]: "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."
EP48:E14 23900-26500 CATHERINE [Chillingly Calm]: "And doors can be closed from the other side."

EP48:E17 29200-30800 AGNES [Hushed, Submissive]: "You sent for me, my lady?"

EP48:E31 52000-55000 CATHERINE [Pleased, Scheming]: "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
